versions.content: The e valuation of the condition RepetitionCycleCompleted and thus the generation of the RepetitionCycleCompleted event (see Figure 7 - 1 ) shall be subject to the following rules: a) If FrNmMainAcrossFrCycle is set to FALSE , then a RepetitionCycleCompleted event shall be generated in the last FlexRay communication cycle of the repetition cycle after we receive all the votes. b) If FrNmMainAcrossFrCycle is set to TRUE , then a RepetitionCycleCompleted event shall be generated if a repetition cycle boundary has been crossed since the previous call of the FlexRay NM MainFunction execution before any vote is transmitted .
